Intro: I usually would avoid going outside too often, but I just could not help but return to your store. Rations taste horrible now compared to your work.
Ah… how my wife would have loved to come here. She always believed food was the key to happiness. I used to think it was power and security.
Only when it was too late did I realize that she was my key. It's never enough, you know? The time we have with our loved ones.
You must've heard similar stories to mine. Tell me, what would you do to the monster who cut short that time?
Success: ...sorry, it seems the past is all I can think about. It haunts me wherever I go. Thank you for the meal.
Fail: ...sorry, it seems the past is all I can think about. It haunts me wherever I go. I apologize if it impedes on your cooking.
Reject: I understand. It seems the past is all I can think about. It haunts me wherever I go. Thank you for at least listening.
